summary.title: Portrait summary for your personal assistant

intro.use: Your portrait, summarized domain by domain. Only approved summaries go to your personal assistant: assistants connected on the Assistants page read them themselves, and you can copy the export text for any other.
intro.full: This level is written from every entry in each domain that still holds, private and sensitive ones included. The last step of a portrait build generates it.
intro.short: This level is shorter and uses only identity, skills, goals, circumstances and preferences at or below the chosen privacy level. Plans, commitments and outdated information are left out.
intro.review: Once the portrait behind a summary changes, or WeClone changes how summaries are written, it stops being exported until it is regenerated and approved again.

assistant.title: Let your personal assistants read your portrait
assistant.intro: Claude Code, Codex and other assistants with MCP support can connect to this WeClone to read the approved parts of your portrait summary and look up entries by keyword or domain. All assistants share one token. The level and domains chosen below decide what they can read, and every call is logged with what it returned.

bots.title: Let chat bots call your clone
bots.intro: Bot platforms such as AstrBot and LangBot call the fine-tuned clone model through an OpenAI-compatible API. All bots share one token, entered as the platform's API key.
bots.tokenLife: A token stays valid once created, server restarts included, until you regenerate or revoke it.
bots.encrypted: Your data is encrypted, and bots read it with the token, without you signing in. Anyone holding both the token and the data on this computer can unlock all of it, so guard the token like a password. Changing your password doesn't affect the token. If you suspect a leak, regenerate it.
bots.noInference: The server hasn't loaded the clone model. Start it as the docs describe before bots can call it.
bots.unused: No bot has used it yet
bots.noTokenHint: Create a token, then enter it as the API key on your bot platform.

setup.once: The token is shown only this once. On your bot platform, add an OpenAI-type model provider with this API base URL:
setup.model: Any model name works, for example gpt-3.5-turbo. The fine-tuned model doesn't call tools, so turn off tools and plugins on the platform. If the bot platform runs in Docker, the address changes, as the docs describe.

about.title: About WeClone
about.tagline: WeClone distills your identity, goals, preferences and current situation from your digital life into a portrait you can review, trace to its sources and share on your own terms. It also analyzes your speaking style.
about.local: Your portrait, review history and settings stay on the computer that runs the server.
about.licenseLine: WeClone is open source under <license>AGPL-3.0</license> and builds on these projects:

build.title: Build portrait
build.intro: Turn your chats into a portrait of you. The build runs in the background, and you open it when it's done.

assistant.label: Personal assistant
assistant.hint: Builds your life portrait and recent events. Personal assistants such as Claude Code, Codex and dots read it and work with you in mind.

clone.label: AI clone
clone.hint: Everything the assistant gets, plus your speaking style, so the clone learns to talk the way you do.
